issue.title: Add Resources Tab with Unit-Synced Content
issue.body: Fluent Mobile's drafting page currently has Bible and Record tabs; this ticket adds Resources as a third tab, positioned second in the tab row. The tab exists as a persistent shell whose content is driven entirely by whichever unit (verse or pericope) is currently selected in Bible or Record, including a tab-wide empty state when the selected unit has no resources of any kind. ## Functional Requirements ### Tab Row - Add a "Resources" tab as the second tab in the drafting page tab row, ordered Bible, Resources, Record. - Keep the Resources tab always visible regardless of whether a unit is selected. ### Content Sync - Populate the Resources tab content only once a unit (verse or pericope) is selected in Bible or Record. - Update the Resources tab content immediately when the selected unit changes, with no loading delay. - Preserve the tab's scroll position, including any open accordion or section, when the translator returns to a previously viewed unit. ### Empty State - Show a centered "No resources available for this verse" message when the selected unit has no resources of any kind. Note: Content sections (Translation Notes, Translation Questions, Images & Maps) are built in #189, #190, and #191; this ticket covers only the tab shell and unit-sync behavior. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth. No product changes invented below.)* ### Product intent (summary) Give drafting a real Resources tab experience: always present as the middle tab, content driven by the currently selected unit, empty when that unit has nothing, with scroll/accordion state restored when returning to a unit. ### Current codebase state - Tab chrome **already exists**: `DraftingTabBar` orders Bible → Resources → Record; `DraftingTab` includes `'resources'`; `DraftingScreen` mounts `ResourcesTab` (kept mounted via `display: 'none'`). - `src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx` is a **placeholder** only — does not read `selectedVerse` or show the specified empty state. - Unit selection today: `DraftingContext.selectedVerse` (verse number), shared by Bible/Record. **Pericope** as a distinct unit type is not modeled in context yet. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Wire `ResourcesTab` to `useDraftingContext()` (and chapter route params as needed) so content keys off the active unit. 2. Add a container that hosts section slots for #189–#191 and computes tab-wide empty: all sections absent/hidden → centered empty copy. 3. Persist per-unit UI state (scroll offset, which section/note accordions are open) in memory keyed by chapter + unit id; restore on unit revisit within the drafting session. 4. Do **not** fetch network in this ticket; sections own load/error (#189–#191); offline backfill is #192. 5. Narrow scope vs inventing tab chrome — extend the stub rather than recreating the tab bar. ### Systems / modules / anchors - `src/app/screens/DraftingScreen.tsx` - `src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx` (primary) - `src/app/context/DraftingContext.tsx` — may need richer unit identity if pericope ≠ verse - `src/components/layout/DraftingTabBar.tsx`, `src/types/drafting/types.ts` - `src/utils/draftingTabState.ts` (pattern for per-chapter tab persistence; mirror for per-unit accordion/scroll) - Empty UI: `src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx` (or match product-centered copy) ### Implementation steps 1. Confirm unit key: verse number vs `bible_text_id` vs future pericope id (see Open questions). 2. Consume selection in `ResourcesTab`; re-render immediately on `selectedVerse` change (no intentional debounce). 3. Add layout shell + empty state when no section has content (coordinate with section “hide when empty” from #189–#191). 4. Implement scroll/accordion restore map keyed by unit. 5. Component tests: empty vs non-empty shell; unit change updates host; restore state on revisit. 6. Leave section bodies as composition points / stubs until #189+. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** Drafting shell (#47 / #236 chrome) already landed. Content sections #189–#191; offline #192. Shared resource **data layer** recommended as a sibling ticket (see split recommendation on the board pass) so sections do not each invent SQLite shapes. - **External:** None for shell/empty/sync-to-selection alone. Resource payloads ultimately need fluent-api (called out on #189–#192). ### Edge cases & failure states - No verse selected yet / verses still loading: define empty vs spinner (product assumes unit selected — match Bible/Record). - Unit change while a section is mid-retry: cancel or ignore stale responses (section tickets; shell should remount or key children by unit). - All sections errored but “would have had content”: empty state vs error-only — **assumption:** empty message is only when no resources exist; section errors render inline in those sections. - Pericope spanning multiple verses: which notes show (union vs primary verse) — open question. ### Testing & verification - Unit/component: `ResourcesTab` + context-driven updates; empty copy exactness. - Manual Android: switch Bible↔Resources↔Record; change verse; confirm immediate update and scroll restore. - Gates: `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci` ### Analytics / observability / migrations - No schema in this ticket unless unit key requires it. - Optional debug logs on unit key change (ids only). ### Assumptions - Tab visibility/order requirements are largely **already met**; remaining work is unit-synced content host + empty state + UI-state restore. - “No loading delay” means no extra Resources-only loading gate beyond instantaneous local reads; section fetch latency is owned by #189–#191/#192. ### Open questions 1. Is “unit” always a single verse today, or must pericope be supported in v1? 2. Exact empty-state copy/placement when some sections error vs truly empty? 3. Should accordion/scroll restore survive leaving `VerseDetail` entirely, or only in-session tab switches? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Resources remains the second drafting tab (Bible, Resources, Record) and stays visible even with no selection content. - [ ] Resources content is driven by the active Bible/Record unit and updates immediately when that unit changes. - [ ] Scroll position and open accordion/section state restore when returning to a previously viewed unit (within the agreed session scope). - [ ] Centered empty message when the unit has no resources of any kind: “No resources available for this verse”. - [ ] Section bodies deferred to #189–#191; this ticket only provides the shell + sync + empty host. - [ ] Tests cover empty host and unit-change behavior.

comments.body:
**Test Results for #188**

- The Resources tab is displayed as the second tab in the Drafting page, in the order Bible → Resources → Record.
- The Resources tab displays the available resources, including Translation Notes, Translation Questions, and Images.
- All resource sections are expandable and can be scrolled through smoothly.
- When the selected verse is changed, the Resources tab updates to display the resources corresponding to the newly selected verse.
- The Resources tab displays content only after a unit (verse or pericope) is selected from the Bible or Record tab.
- The Resources tab content updates immediately when the selected unit changes, without any noticeable loading delay.
- When the selected unit has no available resources, a centered “No resources available for this verse” message is displayed.


Moving this ticket to passedQA
